instruction: Help me to install Papirus icon theme from gnome-look.org and set it as my active icon theme.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Papirus icon theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if icon-theme setting contains 'Papirus' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but targets icon theme instead of gtk theme.

llm_judge_reasons: State extraction is correct: gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface icon-theme is the proper command to check active GNOME icon theme
Metric function is appropriate: check_list with regex pattern matching correctly verifies if 'Papirus' appears in gsettings output
Expected value is semantically correct: Pattern 'Papirus' will match all Papirus variants (Papirus, Papirus-Dark, Papirus-Light, etc.)
Data flow is sound: gsettings command writes to file → cache_file getter reads → check_list performs regex match
Coverage is adequate: While only the 'set as active' requirement is directly verified, this implicitly verifies installation (cannot set non-existent theme)
Runtime feasibility confirmed: gsettings works on GNOME systems, outputs theme name in quotes, and regex will correctly find 'Papirus' substring
